items.title: Utsukushi Village
items.creator: Pixelusion
items.description:
Start your survival journey on this beautiful Japanese village, secrets ready to be discovered and loot to be found. Prepare for the adventure by living and exploring this village!

- Loot everywhere
- Perfect for roleplay
- By Pixelusion and Pixel Smile Studios

items.title: Summer Furniture HD
items.creator: Kreatik Studios
items.description:
Design your tropical island with over 3000 HD summer-themed furniture options! Decorate your house, hut, bungalow, beach, pool & more. Go on holiday to the perfect dream destination, by plane or jetski!

+ Easy tools
+ 55+ unique furniture models
+ 500+ unique textures
+ 12 unique color options
+ Includes custom tropical island world
+ Survival friendly

By Kreatik Studios

items.title: Aqua Park
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
Summer has come! It's time for fun without limits. Visit a huge aqua park world, explore many amazing slides and pools. Take a ride through the aqua cave and enjoy luxury hotels and mansions.

+ Big and small slides
+ Parkour
+ Custom furniture
+ Multiplayer and roleplay
+ Licensed by Pixel Creations and published by BLOCKLAB Studios

items.title: OP Traders Expansion
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
Want to feel what it is like to be overpowered? This map is perfect for you. Explore a rich village filled with super OP traders. 
Get enhanced weapons, armor and tools. Take out an Ender Dragon in a single shot. Receive no damage from the strongest Wither. Gear up and step outside to fight huge OP mobs.
=> OP everything
=> Super strong effects
=> 4 hacker skins, 1 free
items.changelog:
=> Vibrant Visuals compatible
=> Map improvements and bug fixes

items.title: Cottagecore
items.creator: Pixelusion
items.description:
Feel the warm sunlight on your skin, embrace nature and its beauty. As you walk down through the flowers, the cute dresses and the aesthetics of the cottages will accompany you!

- 10 cottagecore skins!
- By Pixelusion & Bone Block Designs

items.title: Wedding - Roleplay World
items.creator: Pickaxe Studios
items.description:
It's time for a wedding!
Do you need a world to roleplay a wedding? This world is perfect!
+ Includes skins.
+ Invite your friends and party!

items.title: WEDDING
items.creator: ChewMingo
items.description:
It's the big wedding day! Join your friends and family and celebrate the big wedding party.
*Great for roleplaying as the bride, groom, and wedding guests
*Includes 10 wedding themed skins

items.title: Pro Hackers
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
Leave the toughest hacking to the experts! Role-play as a real pro and break into systems everywhere to cause problems. Choose from lots of different disguise skins to hide your true face. Time to rule the cyber world!

1 free skin included!

items.title: Chibi Teens
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
Chubby, stubby, and oh so cute! Choose from 12 adorably different skins in the best Japanese anime style. Role-play as a sweet teenager with small mouth, small nose and large eyes. Your head is big, and so is your heart when you’re a childlike chibi teen.

1 free skin included!

items.title: Free Style Teens
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
Anything and everything goes when you’re free. Be as bold as you can when you role-play as a trendsetting teen. Choose from 12 different chic skins in unique outfits you won’t see anywhere else. Others may follow your fashion lead, but your style is still your own.

1 free skin included!

items.title: Teen Love
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
Hugs and kisses all around, when you’re a teen in love! Look adorably cute and choose from 8 different skins in lots of romantic red and pretty pink. Wear your heart on your sleeve, chest, or back. Let everyone know that you have found your true love match.

1 free skin included!

items.title: Famous Cats
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
Face it! You’d love to be a fantastically famous feline! Choose from 12 different cat skins to trot and pace all around. Role-play as a tom or kitten, dressed up in the finest outfits. Everyone will know who you are, you’re fit to be a celebrity.

1 free skin included!

items.title: Anime Tailed Monsters
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
These are some awesome animated beasts of all colors, types, and sizes. Choose from 9 different skins to scare and frighten. Role-play as a manga monster sure to fill all of Minecraft with fear. Shake your tail and show your teeth and watch everyone run far, far, away.

1 free skin included!

items.title: Popular Camo
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
What a way to hide! It’s hard to see you when you look like the most popular blocks. Choose from 12 different skins that are the perfect disguise. Role-play in cool camouflage with only eyes and a mouth to give you away. Will anyone recognize you?

1 free skin included!

items.title: Toy Warden
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
Become a big, bad, cheerful mob from the deep dark biome. Enjoy role-playing as a not so scary warden, with a toy-like look. Choose from 12 different strong boss skins, full of joy and cheer. It will be hard to frighten anyone because you just look too colorful, cute and nice!

1 free skin included!

items.title: Spring Roll
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
Super snacks are here! Choose from 8 deliciously different skins. Role-play as a tasty treat that anyone would want to eat. Look just like a wrapped up roll with yummy filling. Spread your cuteness and happiness all around town and even make mouths water.

1 free skin included!

items.title: Elementals
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
Step out of the mythical world and join the real world. Choose from a dozen different skins that reflect the 4 basic elements: earth, air, fire, and water. Role-play as a legendary being with body and spirit. Search all over Minecraft to find your soul.

1 free skin included!

items.title: Football Teens
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
Kick, catch, or pass? Choose from 12 different sporty skins equipped with helmets, jerseys and football pants. Role-play as a real teen sports hero, ready to make the winning play in your awesome uniform. Help your team to a sweet victory!

1 free skin included!

items.title: Imperial Mobs
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
Look like quite the majestic mob! Choose from 12 different skins complete with lovely crowns and royal robes. Role-play as a boss, neutral or hostile entity in a superior, imperial outfit. Act like a regal ruler and maybe everyone will bow down before you.

1 free skin included!

items.title: Free Trends 2021
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
Be just who you want to be. Enjoy life as you gear up in the best and newest fashions. Role-play and feel free to show off your special unique style. Choose from 12 different skins sporting all the latest design trends. There is no stopping your creativity.

1 free skin included!

items.title: Fainting Goats
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
Jump up as high as you can! It’s easy when you role-play in goat skins. After you’ve reached the heights, try not to faint, but you probably can’t help it. Choose from 12 different options to act like a goat, scale up mountains, and then pass out. Try to recover quickly!

1 free skin included!

items.title: Illusion
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
Such a strange sight! Not just an optical illusion, these are 12 truly trippy skins. Role-play in colorful and crazy designs that look just like a trick of the light. Not able to believe their eyes, everyone will look at you twice, maybe even 3 times. You’re a visual puzzle!

1 free skin included!

items.title: Modern Italian Furniture
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
Modern Italian Furniture includes over 25 furniture pieces and 2 cars you can decorate your new Italian villa with! Decorate your new home like never before!

- Located in a beautiful vineyard
- Has tons of kitchen furniture
- Poolside furniture
- A gaming PC
- Includes 2 sports cars
- Great for roleplay!
- Licensed by 5 Frame Studios and published by BLOCKLAB Studios

items.title: Summer Anime Teens
items.creator: inPixel
items.description:
Summer or not, it's time to throw a Minecraft party! The coolest teens on the server are all coming too so pick your favorite skin, play your favorite gamemodes and just have a good time all the while looking best with these cute and colorful skins!

- 14 skins
- By inPixel
